source: R6 (PLAN.md 11.6). v1 lists the cars that drive today and have a model: the game's own car_sedan (3.0 L), physics_sim's car_hyper and the 2.0 L sedan layouts car_sedan_rwd / car_sedan_awd. Not listed: car_sedan_787b (a rotary race car whose shuffle-mode driveline is a test vehicle, not a road car), the pipes/gen/sim/fuel/x3 variants (engine experiments that share the sedan model), tractor (no road use) - they can be added as plain entries. Paths are relative to the repository root. Chassis mass, box and spawn height are the interim copy of what physics_sim's vehicle files do not carry yet (physics request R5/R6): they equal what rg::Session and the Godot adapter used before the catalog existed. R6c: every entry is one car in the car browser. A base entry names its physics vehicle file; a preset ("preset_of" a base entry listed before it plus "preset_setup", the same option ids and values as a saved setup) is a separate car with its own id, title, subtitle, body type and look, inheriting everything else from its base; the player's own saved setup stays per entry and is applied on top of the preset. "body_type" is an open list; "manufacturer" is optional (none yet); "displacement_l" + "displacement_source" are for engine files without cylinder geometry (simulated engines are computed from bore x stroke x cylinders).

chassis.body_mass_source: [AS] bare shell (owner on PR #22: interior ripped out, no engine assembly, no drivetrain, no wheels; the seats, trim, carpets, audio, spare wheel, bonnet and fasteners are the catalogue's interior parts, the engine, gearbox, driveline, suspension, brakes, steering, wheels, cooling and fuel system are their own parts): a steel monocoque four-door saloon of about 4.6 m - body in white with front and rear subframes 360 kg, doors and boot lid 110, glass 35, bumpers and lights 40, wiring loom, battery and control units 50, exhaust 32, heater and air conditioning 25, pedal box, washer system, jack points and other fixed parts 28 = 680 kg (recalled ranges for a mid-size saloon, nothing cited).
chassis.source: [AS] Initial EV fallback; the garage derives actual mass from shell, battery, motors, running gear and interior.

declared_engine.source: [AS] Two independent 300 kW / 600 Nm electric motors; aggregate shaft ratings before fixed reductions, not measured vehicle performance.

tyre_fitment_source: Initial conservative authored body-specific axle fitment, by dimensions only: the rim of the stock wheel, a width range in 10 mm steps (stock fits; +40 mm over hyper stock, +30 mm over sedan stock) and an overall-diameter tolerance of 12 mm around the axle's own wheel. Every tyre compound (data/tyres/families.json) is offered at every size this allows. Not measured fender clearance; tune against body geometry.
